subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For vLLM and other local providers, should Usage treat missing pricing as a documented local-cost configuration problem, a visible token-only missing-cost state, or a runtime/provider warning?
rationale: Current code already has a usage request/parse path and a missing-cost aggregate path, but the user-visible contract for local-provider unknown pricing and blank Usage-page presentation needs maintainer intent before a safe fix PR.

options.title: Document local pricing and improve missing-cost display
options.body: Keep vLLM cost estimates driven by existing local model cost config while making token-only or missing-cost states visible enough in Usage surfaces.

options.title: Add provider/runtime warning
options.body: Define a shared warning or unknown-cost marker for token-burning models without known pricing, coordinated with the open unknown-pricing issue.

options.title: Treat as support until evidence arrives
options.body: Ask for raw vLLM stream, transcript, endpoint, screenshot, and config evidence before choosing a product change.

recommendation.title: Document local pricing and improve missing-cost display
recommendation.body: Keep vLLM cost estimates driven by existing local model cost config while making token-only or missing-cost states visible enough in Usage surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest verified history is on the usage-cost unknown-pricing behavior that this product choice would extend or preserve.
